examples.english: To give birth to a child.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいアイデアを{産|う}む。

notes:
{産|う}む means to give birth or produce something new.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: {子供|こども}を{産|う}む
- Intransitive pair: {産|う}まれる (to be born)

ASPECT (ている):
{産|う}んでいる can mean "is giving birth" (in progress) or "has given birth" (resultant state, less common).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {子供|こども}を{産|う}む: to give birth to a child
- {卵|たまご}を{産|う}む: to lay eggs
- {利益|りえき}を{産|う}む: to generate profit (figurative)
- アイデアを{産|う}む: to produce ideas

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {産|う}む: give birth, produce (standard)
- {生|う}む: give birth (less common variant)

RELATED:
- {出産|しゅっさん}: childbirth
- {産|う}まれる: to be born
